texts.zh:
在一个有趣的跨文化交流例子中，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上相当数量的年轻人对[owner.GetAdj]的所有事物产生了消费性的兴趣。这些充满激情的年轻人急切地争抢与我们文化相关的任何东西，现在他们构成了这颗星球上一个充满活力和不断发展的亚文化群体。

我们甚至得知即将到来的粉丝大会将举办一场服装大赛。
texts.en:
In an amusing example of cross-cultural exchange, a significant number of young people on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have developed a consuming interest in all things [owner.GetAdj]. Eagerly snatching up anything even remotely connected to our culture, these passionate youngsters now comprise a vibrant and growing subculture on the planet.

We've even been told that an upcoming fan convention will feature a costume contest.

label.zh: 够了，我们的文化只属于我们。
label.en: Enough of this. Our culture is our own.

tooltips.zh: 限制这一情况一定会激起[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]人的反应。
tooltips.en: Restricting this event is sure to precipitate a response from the people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

label.zh: 够了，我们的文化只属于我们。
label.en: Enough of this. Our culture is our own.

label.zh: 假冒者们令人作呕，叫停他们。

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[owner.GetAdj]大会取得了令人振奋的成功！人们不分老幼都聚集在这颗星球上最大的城市，欢庆[owner.GetName]的一切事物。除了大会带来的好意以外，它还为当地经济提供了急需的推动力。

最精彩的也许是扮装比赛，大奖颁发给了我们[owner.GetRulerTitle][owner.GetRulerName]的死忠粉丝。
texts.en:
The [owner.GetAdj] convention on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been a rousing success! Young and old alike gathered in the planet's largest city to celebrate all things [owner.GetName]. Apart from the good will the convention generated, it also provided a much needed boost to the local economy.

Best of all perhaps was the costume contest, in which the grand prize was awarded to a particularly devoted fan of our own [owner.GetRulerTitle] [owner.GetRulerName].

texts.zh: 在我们利用影响力遏制了[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上蓬勃发展的[owner.GetAdj]粉丝群之后，那里的人们都团结起来以传统方式表达自己的文化。因此，艺术和文化部门的产出有了明显的改善。
texts.en: After we used our influence to curtail the burgeoning [owner.GetAdj] fandom on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the people there have rallied around traditional expressions of their own culture. Accordingly, output in the arts and culture sectors has markedly improved.

texts.zh:
我们对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[owner.GetAdj]粉丝采取的强硬态度引起了巨大的反弹。这颗星球上的许多人开始推崇自己的文化和传统，激烈反对[owner.GetAdj]。

这将如何影响两颗星球的外交关系，还有待观察
texts.en:
Our hardline approach to the [owner.GetAdj] fandom on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has precipitated a significant backlash. Rallying around their own culture and traditions, many on the planet have grown virulently anti-[owner.GetAdj].

How this may impact diplomatic relations between our worlds remains to be seen
